name: claude-code-turn
description: A full Claude Code turn: prompt typed, submitted, spinner, status line, and the response frame.
notes: Recorded in a container whose child processes have no Claude credentials, so the turn ends in a login-expired result frame rather than an assistant reply. Everything the emulator is being tested on is present and real — prompt echo, spinner frames, in-place status-line rewrites, OSC title updates, cursor save/restore. Re-record on an authenticated machine with `scripts/capture-vt.py claude-code-turn` to carry a model reply as well; no test needs to change.
